name: Feature Request

labels: enhancement, triage

## Feature Description

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...] -->

**Describe the solution you'd like**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. -->

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
<!-- A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered. -->

## Use Case

**Who would benefit from this feature?**

<!-- Security researchers, pentesters, etc. -->

**What is the expected benefit?**

<!-- Improved testing efficiency, better vulnerability detection, etc. -->

## Proposed Implementation

**How would you like this feature to be implemented?**

<!-- Technical details, API changes, UI changes, etc. -->

**Are there any security considerations?**

<!-- Authorization, consent, audit logging requirements -->

**Does this require changes to:**
- [ ] Domain models
- [ ] Repository interfaces
- [ ] Use cases
- [ ] UI/UX
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests

## Priority

**How important is this feature?**

- [ ] Critical - Blocks security testing workflow
- [ ] High - Significant improvement to testing capability
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have improvement
- [ ] Low - Minor enhancement

## Additional Context

**Screenshots / Mockups**

<!-- If applicable, add screenshots or mockups to illustrate your feature -->

**References**

<!-- Links to similar features, research papers, CVE examples, etc. -->

**Would you be willing to contribute?**

- [ ] Yes, I can submit a PR
- [ ] Yes, I can help test
- [ ] Yes, I can provide feedback
- [ ] No, I cannot contribute at this time

---

**Note:** This tool is for authorized security testing only. All features must maintain authorization enforcement and audit logging.
